label: Машина
description: A 10-sentence usage card for машина (car; machine).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Машина' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Эта' points at a specific car, and 'быстрая' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Машину' is the accusative direct object of 'купил'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'недавно' adds the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Машины' is the genitive required by 'нет' to express having none. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative subject of need. 'Машине' is the dative in the 'нужен' construction, marking what needs something. 'Этой старой' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Машиной' is the instrumental expressing the means of travel. 'В город' is the destination.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В машине' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to express location. 'Тепло' describes the condition inside.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Машины' is the genitive form after 'возле', showing nearness. 'Тебя' is the accusative object of 'жду'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Машины' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'стоят'. 'Чужие' agrees in the plural, and 'на парковке' sets the place.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of quantity. 'Машин' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'на дороге' sets the place.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Машина' is nominative as the subject of 'завелась', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Этим утром' is the instrumental time phrase.
